'''Flight Unlimited Group''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned corporation that specialized in designing high-speed [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lankor VI]] was controlled by them.<ref name="Le facteur X" />

One of the ships they were known to have built was the prototype ''[[Trait Luminique]]''.<ref name="Le facteur X" />
